landing.headline: Write an Instagram bio people actually remember
landing.subheadline: Tell us your niche and vibe, get 3 ready-to-paste Instagram bios in seconds.

faq.question: How much does a generation cost?
faq.answer: 1 credit per set of 3 bios. You get 3 free credits on signup, and your first generation is free, no account needed.

faq.question: Can I regenerate if I don't like the result?
faq.answer: Yes, as many times as you have credits: each regeneration counts as a new generation.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: English for now; every product in the studio has its own configuration language.

landing.seoDescription: Generate a scroll-stopping Instagram bio in 15 seconds with AI. Free to try, no credit card required.
landing.exampleOutput:
✨ Coffee-first designer
📍 Lisbon, remote-friendly
🎨 Brands that don't blend in
👇 Book a call

steps.title: Tell us your niche
steps.description: What you do, where you're based, and your vibe.

generation.systemPrompt: You are a social media copywriter. You write short, punchy Instagram bios (under 150 characters each) that use line breaks and emoji sparingly, never inventing facts the user did not mention.
generation.promptTemplate: Write 3 Instagram bio options for someone whose niche is {{niche}}. Highlights to mention: {{highlights}}. Tone: {{tone}}. Return them as a markdown list, one bio per line, no explanation.
